doc: Mean |first column - last column| over mean |neighbour column difference| (the seam is NOT wrapped in the inner term). Means of float32 rows: the quotient is float32 and the tolerance float32 (observed 6.2e-8 relative against the same image promoted to float64). An isotropic generated map (no seam by construction: ~1). Input convention: the u8 input(s) img are maps stored as bytes, and the function receives them as float32(u8) / float32(255) (`u8.astype(np.float32) / 255.0`: the division is done, and correctly rounded, in float32, as measure.load reads an 8-bit map), NOT as the raw bytes and NOT as a float64 quotient (a texel on a histogram edge or a threshold would move). params.u8_inputs lists them.

u8_inputs.img: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
